newsitem.title: PHILIPPINES: Benpres unit acquires cellular phone firm.
newsitem.headline: Benpres unit acquires cellular phone firm.

text.p: Bayan Telecommunications Holdings Corp, a unit of Benpres Holdings Corp, said on Monday it has acquired a 46.62 percent stake in cellular phone firm Express Telecommunications Co Inc (Extelcom).
In a statement, Bayantel said it acquired the shares from Marifil Holdings Corp.
The amount paid for the shares was not disclosed.
BayanTel president and chairman Eugenio Lopez Jr said Benpres' acquisition will allow the company to become a full service provider of telecommunications services.
Extelcom is one of five cellular mobile phone companies in the country.
BayanTel owns ICC Telecoms which operates an international gateway facility (IGF) and a local exchange network.
BayanTel is 67 percent owned by Benpres, Other stockholders include Nynex Corp and Telecom Holdings Co Ltd of Thailand.
